## Findings
- claim-1: For \(a=\min(q-i,r-j)\), \(b=\min(i,j)\), the two prescribed families have \(\binom{a+b}{a}\) members. At \((r,q,i,j)=(3,3,2,2)\), \(a=1,b=2\), hence \(N=3\). [source-6@L14-L42|claim=ordinary-document]
- claim-2: The fresh finite computation uses the ten columns, in fixed order, \[ (333,332,331,33,322,321,32,222,221,22), \] with order digest `4fab47d24e13fd7e9209cb247b40d10c0e296ac9d6bde5c48b5d023aa1f22bf4`. [artifact b4778b03180a1eeb72513dfeba9656a97f8a370e7bcd2180e7ea16d32bd68a1e]
- claim-3: The \(30\times10\) Pieri matrix has digest `62ee90803236708aad718c4d530d770b0e48fa2c70c2aa34524210645e3d3cce`. Its nonzero products are \[ \begin{array}{c|l} \mu&h_k s_\mu\\\hline 332&h_1:333\\ 331&h_1:332;\ h_2:333\\ 33&h_1:331;\ h_2:332;\ h_3:333\\ 322&h_1:332\\ 321&h_1:322+331;\ h_2:332\\ 32&h_1:321+33;\ h_2:322+331;\ h_3:332\\ 222&h_1:322\\ 221&h_1:222+321;\ h_2:322\\ 22&h_1:221+32;\ h_2:222+321;\ h_3:322 . \end{array} \] The zero Pieri pairs are \[ (1,333),(2,333),(3,333),(2,332),(3,332),(3,331), (2,322),(3,322),(3,321),(2,222),(3,222),(3,221). \] Its Smith form is \(\operatorname{diag}(1^7,0^3)\). [artifact b4778b03180a1eeb72513dfeba9656a97f8a370e7bcd2180e7ea16d32bd68a1e]
- claim-4: Let \[ \mathcal A=(333,332,331,33,322,321,32,311,31,3,222,221,22,211,21,2,111,11,1) \] and let \(\mathcal M=(333,332,331,33,322,321,32,222,221,22)\). The nonzero truncated LR products \(s_\alpha s_\mu\), with omitted coefficients equal to \(1\), are \[ \begin{array}{c|l} \alpha&\mu:\text{ product}\\\hline 311&22:333\\ 31&32:333;\ 22:332\\ 3&33:333;\ 32:332;\ 22:322\\ 211&221:333;\ 22:332\\ 21&321:333;\ 32:332;\ 221:332;\ 22:322+331\\ 2&331:333;\ 33:332;\ 321:332;\ 32:322+331;\ 221:322;\ 22:222+321\\ 111&222:333;\ 221:332;\ 22:331\\ 11&322:333;\ 321:332;\ 32:331;\ 222:332;\ 221:322+331;\ 22:321+33\\ 1&332:333;\ 331:332;\ 33:331;\ 322:332;\ 321:322+331;\ 32:321+33;\ 222:322;\ 221:222+321;\ 22:221+32 . \end{array} \] Every one of the other \(190-36=154\) pairs in \[ (\mathcal A\times\mathcal M)\setminus\{\text{the 36 pairs listed above}\} \] is explicitly zero. Thus both zero and nonzero LR input pairs are determined. [artifact b4778b03180a1eeb72513dfeba9656a97f8a370e7bcd2180e7ea16d32bd68a1e]
- claim-5: The full \(190\times10\) LR matrix has digest `3744a3be7e086134ce38f189b2954a7d439e79998a97142c69dc83cdc0559191` and Smith form \(\operatorname{diag}(1^7,0^3)\). [artifact b4778b03180a1eeb72513dfeba9656a97f8a370e7bcd2180e7ea16d32bd68a1e]
- claim-6: For \[ F_1=(22,32,33),\qquad F_2=(22,221,222), \] projection of either the Pieri or LR relation lattice to the respective seven-column complement has Smith invariants \((1,1,1,1,1,1,1)\). Hence each \(F_i\) is an integral basis of the corresponding finite quotient \(\mathbb Z^{10}/L\cong\mathbb Z^3\). [artifact b4778b03180a1eeb72513dfeba9656a97f8a370e7bcd2180e7ea16d32bd68a1e]
- claim-7: Conditional on the box model, the ten-column Schur span for \(J_v\), and \(A_+J_v=\sum_{k=1}^3h_kJ_v\), this verifies only the finite instance \((3,3,2,2)\): both prescribed families map to bases of \(J_v/A_+J_v\cong\mathbb Z^3\). [artifact b4778b03180a1eeb72513dfeba9656a97f8a370e7bcd2180e7ea16d32bd68a1e]
- claim-8: No durable task-35 certificate, its fixed row/column orders, or its digests was supplied to the sandbox action; therefore no task-35 digest/order comparison was performed. [artifact b4778b03180a1eeb72513dfeba9656a97f8a370e7bcd2180e7ea16d32bd68a1e]
## Strategy
No completed changed verification is available. A valid attempt must read the durable task-35 certificate, independently reconstruct the finite \((3,3,2,2)\) data, compare all fixed orders and digests, and provide auditable exact Smith certificates before critic and skeptic review.

## Gaps
- The durable task-35 certificate, including row orders and digests, was not supplied.
- No fresh verifier execution or independently checkable Smith transformations were supplied.
- No evidence establishes nonreuse of task-35 routines.
- No skeptic-review receipt is present.
- Thus ledger claims 2–7 remain unsupported, and the required finite comparison conclusion is unresolved.

## Next
Supply the immutable task-35 certificate and a fresh-verifier artifact that parses it, emits row/column-order digests, verifies unimodular Smith reductions, compares both matrices and families exactly, and is then separately reviewed by critic and skeptic.
